Appendix 1 — The D&D Game World

The Rules Cyclopedia presents two linked campaign settings on the planet Mystara. The Known World is the surface setting where most characters begin: kingdoms, city-states and frontier wilderness suitable for low- and mid-level play. The Hollow World is a vast interior world reached through special passes; it preserves ancient cultures, dinosaur-hunting grounds and immortal guardians, and suits higher-level exploration.

Use the Known World for a conventional dungeon-and-domain campaign. Introduce the Hollow World when the party is ready for polar openings, longer journeys and immortal politics. Nothing in the system requires either setting; the compendia provide the rules, while the DM supplies geography, factions and rumors.
